result.question: What is Louise Bourgeois's Ode to My Mother made of?
result.answer: The corpus does not record what Louise Bourgeois's Ode to My Mother is made of. The only record that mentions Ode to My Mother (cma-160794) is a catalog entry for an etching and drypoint print titled "Untitled" (1995). That record describes the work as one of nine illustrations issued in a portfolio with poetic text, and it discusses the spider as a mother figure in Ode to My Mother. It does not state the materials of the Ode to My Mother series as a whole. The medium it lists (etching and drypoint) belongs to that specific print, and I cannot confirm from the corpus that it applies to the whole Ode to My Mother work.
result.limitations: The corpus has no record for Ode to My Mother itself, so its overall material is not recorded. The only related record is a print (etching and drypoint) from the same series, and its medium should not be assumed to describe the whole series.
